text:
The bug is in `src/cachetools/__init__.py`, `TLRUCache.__setitem__`.

When an existing key is reassigned, `__setitem__` replaces `self.__items[key]` with a new `_Item` and pushes that item onto the heap, but it does not mark the previous `_Item` as `removed`. The old heap entry therefore remains active. When its original expiry is reached, `expire()` removes the current value and deletes the current `__items` entry, even though the key has a newer expiry.

I will mark the existing heap item as removed before installing the replacement item, so the stale heap entry is ignored while the new expiry remains authoritative.
